## Outcomes and limits

What worked, failed, contradicted, remained unknown or was blocked? What was not independently validated? Are outputs safe to publish?

Compare the result with the task's prediction and falsifier. State which biological explanation gained or lost support, or why the data could not distinguish them. Identify the independent observation that would resolve the remaining uncertainty.

## Acceptance and next step

Which task acceptance checks passed; which didn't? Next bounded task or blocker. No personal/sample-level data, clinical claims or outreach.
